t: Highly versatile drill bit allows accurate drilling into various materials, such as brick, cement, sheet metal, wood, plastic, aluminium and soft wall tiles. Features hardened steel straight shank and sharpened tungsten carbide tip for improved bit penetration, outstanding durability and consistent drilling life. Allows fast drilling even in hard materials. Optimised flute design enables efficient debris removal. Ideal for building trades. Compatible with most power tool brands.
b: Suitable for Masonry, Plastic, Metal & Wood
